title: Approved PHP coding standards map to PHPCS, Coder, or PHP_CodeSniffer work
summary: The Drupal Coding Standards process describes how approved PHP standards are handled depending on whether a PHPCS rule exists, needs modification in Coder, or needs new support in Coder or PHP_CodeSniffer.

sources.locator: When a PHP standard is approved
sources.title: Coding Standards project

drupal_core.notes: This is a process and tooling relationship for current Drupal Coding Standards.

actions: Prefer automated PHPCS/Coder/PHP_CodeSniffer support where a Drupal PHP coding standard has an available rule.
Track missing or modified rule support separately from the approved standard itself.
checks: Confirm whether a PHP coding-standard rule is already represented by project tooling before treating it as manually checked only.
evidence_requirements: Project PHPCS/Coder/PHP_CodeSniffer configuration when evaluating a repository
automation_hints: Future analyzer profiles can map reviewed coding-standard records to configured Coder or PHP_CodeSniffer rules.

enforcement.rationale: This record describes tooling provenance; actual coding-standard findings require rule-specific records and project tooling evidence.
